text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From the Oka Sho to the Japanese Derby… Vodka continues to ponder over whether or not she should take on this unprecedented challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka asks Narita Brian for advice based on her experience with the Derby, and gets told to follow her gut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The words make Vodka rethink everything, and she realizes that it's her true nature to do what she wants—no matter how reckless it is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to stay true to herself, Vodka decides to run in the Japanese Derby instead of the Japanese Oaks.
